questions.prompt: Which opening is best for a discovery call?
options: Let me show you our chatbot
Walk me through the last time this problem happened
questions.explanation: Ask about the problem and a concrete example before proposing solutions.

questions.prompt: Which are good, measurable success criteria?
options: Median first response under 1 minute (message timestamps)
70% of a 50-question FAQ set answered correctly without staff
questions.explanation: Good criteria have numbers, baselines and a measurement method.

questions.prompt: What must every architecture component have?
questions.explanation: If you can't justify a component in one line, remove or rethink it.

questions.prompt: Everything runs on one VPS. How should the doc treat it?
options: Name it as a single point of failure with mitigations (alerts, backups, rebuild runbook) and residual risk
questions.explanation: Honest SPOF tables with mitigations are expected.

questions.prompt: Best basis for the AI part of the monthly estimate?
options: Measured tokens per conversation from your evals × expected volume × current prices
The cheapest model's list price only
questions.explanation: Use measured usage and cite the price source and date.

questions.prompt: The client asks for a big feature mid-build. Best reply?
options: Restate the need, show impact on scope/time/cost, offer options with a recommendation, get a written decision
questions.explanation: Make trade-offs visible and decide in writing.

questions.prompt: What keeps AI-assisted work safe to merge?
options: Small PRs, tests, 'How I verified this', and explain-back
questions.explanation: Small verified diffs the author can explain.

questions.prompt: An AI patch turns tests green but also edited a test and replaced an ownership check with a role check. What do you do?
options: Treat as suspicious: restore the check, restore the test, find the real bug, add regression tests
Ask the AI if it is sure
questions.explanation: Edited tests and weakened checks are classic signs of a bad fix.

questions.prompt: Which belongs on a pre-launch checklist?
options: Rehearsed rollback and a timed restore drill
questions.explanation: Operations evidence is part of readiness.

questions.prompt: Local setup and deployment setup instructions should be mixed together to keep the README short.
questions.explanation: Separating them avoids running production steps locally or vice versa.

questions.prompt: What belongs in the README's AI section?
options: Which parts AI helped with, how each was verified, and where the AI was wrong
questions.explanation: Honest accounting shows judgement and builds trust.
